source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 3 (PDF 46-73), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 3 (Chemical Bonding) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The force that holds together two or more atoms, molecules or ions is called a:
(Woh force jo do ya zyada atoms, molecules ya ions ko aapas mein jor kar rakhti hai, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chemical bond (kimiyai bandhan) woh force hai jo atoms, molecules ya ions ko jor kar rakhti hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: A chemical bond is the force that holds together two or more atoms, molecules or ions.

blocks.prompt:
2 Van der Waals forces are usually not termed pure chemical bonds because they are:
(Van der Waals forces ko aam taur par khalis chemical bonds kyun nahi kaha jata?)
blocks.explanation: Van der Waals forces kamzor hoti hain, is liye inhein khalis chemical bonds nahi kaha jata (3.1).

book_ref.quote: being weak enough, van der Waals forces are usually not termed as pure chemical bonds

blocks.prompt:
3 According to the Lewis concept, atoms form bonds in order to:
(Lewis concept ke mutabiq atoms bonds kyun banate hain?)

options.text: shells ki tadaad barhane ke liye
saare valence electrons khone ke liye
bairooni shell mukammal kar ke noble gas jaisi configuration paane ke liye

blocks.explanation: Atoms apni bairooni shell mukammal kar ke noble gas jaisi configuration haasil karne ke liye bond banate hain, aksar octet (3.1).

book_ref.quote: atoms make bonds to complete their outermost shells to have noble gas-like configuration

blocks.prompt:
4 Which statement about NaCl and water is given in the chapter?
(NaCl aur paani ke baare mein chapter mein kaunsa bayan diya gaya hai?)

options.text: NaCl covalent aur liquid; paani ionic aur solid
NaCl ionic aur solid; paani covalent aur liquid

blocks.explanation: NaCl ionic aur solid hai, jab ke paani covalent aur liquid hai; properties bond ki qisam par munhasir hain (3.1).

book_ref.quote: NaCl has ionic bond and is solid, but water is a covalent compound and liquid.

blocks.prompt:
5 According to the Lewis theory, an ionic bond is formed by:
(Lewis theory ke mutabiq ionic bond kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ionic bond electrons ki mukammal muntaqili (complete transfer) se banta hai: kam ionization energy wale atom se zyada electron affinity wale atom ki taraf (3.1.1).

book_ref.quote: the ionic bond is formed by the complete transfer of electrons from an atom with low ionization energy

blocks.prompt:
6 In ionic bond formation, electrons pass from an atom with low ionization energy to an atom with:
(Ionic bond mein electrons kam ionization energy wale atom se kis qisam ke atom ki taraf jaate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Electrons zyada electron affinity wale atom ki taraf jaate hain (3.1.1).

book_ref.quote: to another atom with high electron affinity

blocks.prompt:
7 When Na (2, 8, 1) loses one electron, the Na⁺ ion has the electron configuration of:
(Jab Na (2, 8, 1) aik electron khota hai to Na⁺ ion ki electron configuration kis noble gas jaisi hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Na⁺ (2, 8) ki configuration ₁₀Ne jaisi hai, jo is ke qareeb tareen noble gas hai (3.1.1).

book_ref.quote: which has the electron configuration of ₁₀Ne, a noble gas nearest to it

blocks.prompt:
8 The electron arrangement of the chloride ion Cl⁻ is:
(Chloride ion Cl⁻ ki electron tarteeb kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cl (2, 8, 7) aik electron le kar Cl⁻ (2, 8, 8) banta hai, jo noble gas jaisi tarteeb hai (3.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Chlorine atom Cl (2, 8, 7) gains one electron to form the chloride ion

blocks.prompt:
9 An ionic bond like that in NaCl is expected between:
(NaCl jaisa ionic bond kin elements ke darmiyan mutawaqqa hai?)

options.text: group 1 aur 2 ki metals aur group 16 aur 17 ke elements

blocks.explanation: Isi tarah ka ionic bond group 1 aur 2 ki metals aur group 16 aur 17 ke elements ke darmiyan mutawaqqa hai (3.1.1).

book_ref.quote: A similar type of bond is expected between group 1 and 2 metals and groups 16 and 17 elements.

blocks.prompt:
10 A covalent bond is formed by:
(Covalent bond kaise banta hai?)

options.text: do atoms ke darmiyan electrons ki baahmi sharing
mukhalif charge wale ions ki kashish

blocks.explanation: Covalent bond do atoms ke darmiyan electrons ki baahmi sharing (mutual sharing) se banta hai (3.1.2).

book_ref.quote: A covalent bond is formed by the mutual sharing of electrons between two atoms.

blocks.prompt:
11 The bond in the Cl₂ molecule is:
(Cl₂ molecule mein bond kis qisam ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do Cl atoms ka bond khalis covalent aur non-polar hai kyun ke dono ki electronegativity barabar hai (3.1.2).

book_ref.quote: The bond between two Cl atoms is purely covalent and non-polar.

blocks.prompt:
12 In a non-polar bond such as Cl–Cl, the bonded atoms:
(Cl–Cl jaise non-polar bond mein bonded atoms ki kya kaifiyat hoti hai?)

options.text: poore positive aur negative charge rakhte hain
partial charges δ⁺ aur δ⁻ rakhte hain
barqi taur par neutral rehte hain, kisi par charge nahi

blocks.explanation: Electronegativity bilkul barabar hone se bonded atoms barqi taur par neutral rehte hain (3.1.2).

book_ref.quote: the bonded atoms remain electrically neutral and there is no charge on either atom

blocks.prompt:
13 Which of the following contains a polar covalent bond?
(In mein se kis mein polar covalent bond hai?)
blocks.explanation: H–Cl, H–Br aur H₂O polar covalent hain; H₂, F₂, Br₂, I₂ non-polar hain (3.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Examples of polar covalent bonds are H–Cl, H-Br, H₂O, etc.

blocks.prompt:
14 Which molecule has a non-polar covalent bond like Cl₂?
(Kis molecule mein Cl₂ jaisa non-polar covalent bond hai?)
blocks.explanation: H₂, F₂, Br₂ aur I₂, Cl₂ ki tarah non-polar hain (3.1.2).

book_ref.quote: The other such molecules are H₂, F₂, Br₂ and I₂.

blocks.text: Dative bond (coordinate covalent bond), printed as 3.13

blocks.prompt:
15 A bond in which the shared pair of electrons is donated by only one of the bonding atoms is:
(Woh bond jis mein shared electron pair sirf aik bonding atom deta hai, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dative (coordinate covalent) bond tab banta hai jab shared pair aik hi atom deta hai (3.13).

book_ref.quote: A dative bond is formed between two atoms when the shared pair of electrons is donated by one of the bonding atoms.

blocks.prompt:
16 In the formation of H₃O⁺ from H₂O and H⁺, the donor of the electron pair is:
(H₂O aur H⁺ se H₃O⁺ bante waqt electron pair kaun deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxygen apna lone pair electron ki kami wale proton ko deta hai aur dative bond banta hai (3.13).

book_ref.quote: the oxygen atom can donate its lone pair of electrons to the acceptor H⁺

blocks.prompt:
17 How many lone pairs of electrons are present on the oxygen atom of a water molecule?
(Paani ke molecule mein oxygen atom par kitne lone pairs hain?)
blocks.explanation: H₂O mein do covalent bonds aur oxygen par do lone pairs hain (3.13).

book_ref.quote: H₂O has two covalent bonds and there are two lone pairs of electrons on the oxygen atom

blocks.prompt:
18 In carbon monoxide, the dative bond is formed when:
(Carbon monoxide mein dative bond kaise banta hai?)

options.text: carbon oxygen ko lone pair deta hai
carbon do electrons oxygen ko muntaqil karta hai
oxygen apna aik lone pair carbon ko deta hai

blocks.explanation: Carbon ko octet ke liye aik aur pair chahiye; oxygen apna aik lone pair deta hai, yun dative bond banta hai (3.13).

book_ref.quote: Oxygen atom donates one of its lone pairs for the formation of a covalent bond

blocks.prompt:
19 In the ozone molecule, the central oxygen atom has:
(Ozone molecule mein darmiyani oxygen atom ke kitne aur kaise bonds hain?)

options.text: aik taraf double covalent bond aur doosri taraf coordinate covalent bond

blocks.explanation: Darmiyani O ke kul teen bonds hain: aik taraf double covalent bond aur doosri taraf coordinate bond (3.13).

book_ref.quote: the central atom has total three bonds including a double covalent bond on one side

blocks.prompt:
20 In ozone, the oxygen atom that accepts the lone pair carries:
(Ozone mein jo oxygen atom lone pair qubool karta hai us par kaunsa charge hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Darmiyani (dene wala) O positive aur qubool karne wala O negative charge rakhta hai (3.13).

book_ref.quote: It carries a positive charge, while the oxygen atom that accepts the lone pair carries a negative charge.

blocks.prompt:
21 Which of the following polyatomic ions carries a positive charge?
(In mein se kaunsa polyatomic ion positive charge rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ammonium ion NH₄⁺ ke ilawa yeh polyatomic ions aksar negative charge rakhte hain (3.1.4).

book_ref.quote: With the exception of ammonium ion (NH₄⁺), these ions mostly carry a negative charge

blocks.prompt:
22 The correct formula of the nitrate ion is:
(Nitrate ion ka durust formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrate par aik negative charge hai: N (+5) + 3 × O (−2) = −1, is liye NO₃⁻ (book correction, 3.1.4).

book_ref.quote: The nitrate ion carries one negative charge

blocks.prompt:
23 Which of the following ions is given as an example of an expanded octet?
(In mein se kaunsa ion expanded octet ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: SO₄²⁻, ClO₄⁻ aur PO₄³⁻ expanded octet ki numayan misalein hain (3.1.4).

book_ref.quote: the central atom violates the octet rule by expanding its electron density to the higher orbitals

blocks.prompt:
24 How many electrons are present in the valence shell of S in SO₄²⁻?
(SO₄²⁻ mein S ki valence shell mein kitne electrons hain?)
blocks.explanation: Do double aur do single bonds: 2(4) + 2(2) = 12 electrons, octet se 4 zyada (3.1.4).

book_ref.quote: Thus, S has 12 electrons in its valence shell and it exceeds the octet by 4 electrons.

blocks.prompt:
25 The expansion of the octet of S in SO₄²⁻ is caused by:
(SO₄²⁻ mein S ka octet kyun phail jaata hai?)

options.text: electrons ka sirf oxygen ko jana
d orbitals ka bonding mein shamil hona

blocks.explanation: d orbital bonding mein hissa leta hai aur zaid electrons ko jagah deta hai (3.1.4).

book_ref.quote: The expansion of octet is caused by the involvement of the d orbital in bonding

blocks.prompt:
26 When one 3p electron of sulfur moves into a 3d orbital, the number of unpaired electrons becomes:
(Jab sulfur ka aik 3p electron 3d orbital mein jaata hai to unpaired electrons kitne ho jaate hain?)
blocks.explanation: 3s² 3p³ 3d¹ mein chaar unpaired electrons hain, jo SO₂ mein istemal hoti hai; 3s electron bhi barhane se chhe ho jaate hain (3.1.4).

book_ref.quote: The presence of d-orbital allows this configuration to extend to 4 unpaired electrons by the transfer of one electron from the 3p pair

blocks.prompt:
27 For the six bonds of sulfur in SO₄²⁻, the excited sulfur atom needs how many unpaired electrons?
(SO₄²⁻ mein sulfur ke chhe bonds ke liye excited sulfur atom ko kitne unpaired electrons chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: SO₄²⁻ mein S ki chhe bonds wali haalat 3s¹ 3p³ 3d² hai jis mein chhe unpaired electrons hain (3.1.4, box diagram).

book_ref.quote: Thus, S has 12 electrons in its valence shell and it exceeds the octet by 4 electrons.

blocks.prompt:
28 The central iodine atom of I₃⁻ exceeds the octet by:
(I₃⁻ ka darmiyani iodine atom octet se kitne electrons zyada rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2 bonds × 2 + 3 lone pairs × 2 = 10 electrons, yani octet 2 electrons se phailta hai (3.1.4).

book_ref.quote: has 10 electrons in the valence shell and the octet expands by two electrons

blocks.prompt:
29 The availability of d orbitals in sulfur also explains:
(Sulfur mein d orbitals ki maujoodgi aur kis cheez ki wazahat karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada unpaired electrons tak phailao S ki mukhtalif oxidation states aur zaid electrons qubool karne ki wazahat karta hai (3.1.4).

book_ref.quote: It explains not only the variable oxidation states of S

blocks.prompt:
30 Using the chapter's counting method (2 electrons per single bond), how many electrons surround S in SF₆?
(Chapter ke tareeqe se (har single bond ke 2 electrons), SF₆ mein S ke gird kitne electrons hain?)
blocks.explanation: SF₆ mein chhe S–F single bonds hain: 6 × 2 = 12 electrons, yani expanded octet (3.1.4, 3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: The Lewis structure of SF₆ is given in Figure 3.19, it shows that this is an AB₆ type molecule.

blocks.prompt:
31 Counting 2 electrons for each bond, by how many electrons does P in PCl₅ exceed the octet?
(Har bond ke 2 electrons gin kar, PCl₅ mein P octet se kitne electrons zyada rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paanch P–Cl bonds: 5 × 2 = 10 electrons, yani 10 − 8 = 2 octet se zyada (3.1.4, 3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: This is evident from the geometry of the PCl₅ molecule given in Figure 3.17.

blocks.text: 3.2 Electronegativity and the type of bond

blocks.prompt:
32 The difference in electronegativity of two bonded atoms gives an approximate measure of:
(Do bonded atoms ki electronegativity ka farq kis cheez ka andaaza deta hai?)

options.text: bond ki polarity aur bond ki qisam

blocks.explanation: Electronegativity ka farq bond ki polarity aur bond ki qisam ka andaaza deta hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: provides an approximate measure of the bond polarity and an indication of the type of bond

blocks.prompt:
33 Two atoms with an electronegativity difference less than 0.4 form a:
(Jin do atoms ki electronegativity ka farq 0.4 se kam ho woh kaunsa bond banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: 0.4 se kam farq ka matlab khalis covalent bond (3.2).

book_ref.quote: Two atoms having electronegativity difference less than 0.4 are said to make a pure covalent bond.

blocks.prompt:
34 Electronegativities: N = 3.0 and H = 2.1 (given). The N–H bond is:
(Electronegativities: N = 3.0 aur H = 2.1 (diye gaye). N–H bond kis qisam ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Farq = 3.0 − 2.1 = 0.9, jo 0.4 aur 1.8 ke darmiyan hai: polar covalent (3.2).

book_ref.quote: An electronegativity difference between 0.4 and 1.8 corresponds to a polar covalent bond

blocks.prompt:
35 Electronegativities: Li = 1.0 and F = 4.0 (given). The bond between Li and F is:
(Electronegativities: Li = 1.0 aur F = 4.0 (diye gaye). Li aur F ka bond kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Farq = 4.0 − 1.0 = 3.0, jo 1.8 se zyada hai, is liye bond ionic hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: whereas, above this value the bond between two atoms will be ionic in nature

blocks.prompt:
36 The electronegativity difference in NaCl, as given in the chapter, is:
(Chapter ke mutabiq NaCl mein electronegativity ka farq kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: H–H, H–Cl aur NaCl ke farq tarteeb se 0, 0.9 aur 2.1 hain (3.2).

book_ref.quote: are 0 (nonpolar), 0.9 (polar covalent), and 2.1 (ionic), respectively

blocks.prompt:
37 Electronegativities: C = 2.5 and Cl = 3.0 (given). The C–Cl bond is:
(Electronegativities: C = 2.5 aur Cl = 3.0 (diye gaye). C–Cl bond kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Farq = 3.0 − 2.5 = 0.5, jo 0.4 aur 1.8 ke darmiyan hai: polar covalent (3.2).

book_ref.quote: When this difference is very small or zero, the bond is covalent and nonpolar.

blocks.text: Dipole moment and polarity of molecules

blocks.prompt:
38 A molecule with δ⁺ charge on one part and δ⁻ charge on the other part is called a:
(Woh molecule jis ke aik hisse par δ⁺ aur doosre par δ⁻ charge ho, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aisa molecule dipole kehlata hai aur us ka dipole moment hota hai.

book_ref.quote: A molecule with δ⁺ charge on one part and δ⁻ charge on the other part is called a dipole

blocks.prompt:
39 The unit in which dipole moment is measured is:
(Dipole moment kis unit mein naapa jaata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dipole moment Debye (D) mein naapa jaata hai; zyada dipole moment ka matlab zyada polarity.

book_ref.quote: Dipole moment is measured in Debye unit (D).

blocks.prompt:
40 In the chapter's convention, the dipole moment of HF is directed:
(Chapter ke tareeqe mein HF ka dipole moment kis taraf hota hai?)

options.text: kisi taraf nahi, kyun ke zero hai

blocks.explanation: Diatomic molecules ka dipole moment δ⁺ sire se δ⁻ sire ki taraf hota hai, yani H se F (Fig. 3.5).

book_ref.quote: are directed from the positive ends (δ⁺) to negative ends (δ⁻)

blocks.prompt:
41 The dipole moment of water given in the chapter is:
(Chapter mein paani ka dipole moment kitna diya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paani ka dipole moment 1.85 D hai, hydrogen wale sire se oxygen ki taraf.

book_ref.quote: The dipole moment of water is 1.85 D

blocks.prompt:
42 The non-zero dipole moment of water shows that the water molecule is:
(Paani ka non-zero dipole moment kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Linear H–O–H ka dipole moment zero hota; non-zero qeemat batati hai ke paani non-linear (v-shaped) hai.

book_ref.quote: A linear H₂O molecule (H-O-H) would have zero dipole moment.

blocks.prompt:
43 The dipole moment of SO₂ given in the chapter is:
(Chapter mein SO₂ ka dipole moment kitna diya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: SO₂ ka dipole moment 1.61 D hai, paani ke ulat simt mein.

book_ref.quote: SO₂ has a dipole moment of 1.61 D

blocks.prompt:
44 CCl₄ is a non-polar molecule although its C–Cl bonds are polar, because:
(CCl₄ ke C–Cl bonds polar hain phir bhi molecule non-polar kyun hai?)

options.text: C aur Cl ki electronegativity barabar hai
mukammal tetrahedron mein chaaron bond moments aik doosre ko khatam kar dete hain
carbon par do lone pairs hain

blocks.explanation: Chaaron C–Cl bond moments aise simt mein hain ke aik doosre ko khatam kar dete hain; kul dipole moment zero.

book_ref.quote: The net dipole moment of the CCl₄ molecule is zero making it a non-polar molecule.

blocks.prompt:
45 Which of the following molecules has zero dipole moment because of its trigonal planar symmetry?
(Kaunsa molecule trigonal planar symmetry ki wajah se zero dipole moment rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: BF₃ ki symmetrical trigonal planar banawat hai aur dipole moment zero hai.

book_ref.quote: BF₃ has a trigonal planar symmetrical structure and its dipole moment is also zero

blocks.prompt:
46 H₂S has some net dipole moment because:
(H₂S ka kuch kul dipole moment kyun hai?)

options.text: yeh non-linear hai, is liye polar bond moments khatam nahi hote

blocks.explanation: H₂S non-linear hai; is ke polar bond moments khatam nahi hote, is liye kuch dipole moment hai.

book_ref.quote: H₂S is also a non-linear molecule as the individual bonds are polar

blocks.prompt:
47 As a rule, a molecule with the same ligands around the central atom in a regular geometry is:
(Usool ke taur par jis molecule mein central atom ke gird aik jaise ligands regular geometry mein hon, woh kaisa hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aise molecules mein alag alag dipole moments zero nahi hote, magar kul dipole moment zero hota hai; molecule non-polar hai.

book_ref.quote: the molecules that have same ligands (atoms or groups of atoms with the central atom) in a regular geometry

blocks.text: 3.3.2 Valence shell electron pair repulsion model (VSEPR)

blocks.prompt:
48 The VSEPR model was presented by:
(VSEPR model kis ne pesh kiya?)
blocks.explanation: VSEPR model Sidgwick aur Powell ne 1940 mein pesh kiya (3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: This model was presented by Sidgwick and Powell in 1940.

blocks.prompt:
49 The VSEPR model assumes that a molecule takes a shape in which:
(VSEPR model ke mutabiq molecule aisi shakal ikhtiyar karta hai jis mein:)

options.text: valence electron pairs ki repulsion (dafa) kam se kam ho
lone pairs ko nazar andaaz kiya jaye

blocks.explanation: Molecule aisi shakal leta hai jis mein valence electrons ki dafa (repulsion) kam se kam ho (3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: a molecule will take a shape such that the electronic repulsions among the valence electrons of that atom are minimum

blocks.prompt:
50 The correct order of repulsions between electron pairs is:
(Electron pairs ke darmiyan repulsion ki durust tarteeb kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Repulsion is tarteeb se kam hoti hai: lp-lp > lp-bp > bp-bp (3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Lone pair-lone pair (lp-lp) > lone pair-bond pair (lp-bp) > bond pair-bond pair (bp-bp)

blocks.prompt:
51 Lone pairs compress the bond pairs because lone pairs:
(Lone pairs bond pairs ko kyun dabate hain?)

options.text: bond pairs se kam jagah gherte hain
do nuclei mein shared hote hain
bond pairs se zyada jagah gherte hain

blocks.explanation: Lone pair electrons zyada jagah gherte hain, is liye bond pairs par zyada dafa daal kar unhein dabate hain (3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: The electrons of lone pairs occupy more space than the bond pairs.

blocks.prompt:
52 In the VSEPR model, the two electron pairs of a double bond are regarded as:
(VSEPR model mein double bond ke do electron pairs ko kya samjha jaata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Double ya triple bond ke pairs mein charge density zyada hoti hai magar unhein aik hi pair samjha jaata hai (3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: contain a higher electronic charge density, but they are regarded as single pairs

blocks.prompt:
53 To predict a shape, the central atom is mostly chosen as the:
(Shakal maloom karne ke liye central atom aam taur par kaunsa chuna jaata hai?)

options.text: jo sab se zyada tadaad mein ho

blocks.explanation: Sab se kam electronegative atom, ya jis element ke sab se kam atoms hon, central atom chuna jaata hai (3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: The least electronegative atom or the element with the least number of atoms is mostly selected as the central atom.

blocks.prompt:
54 The actual shape of a molecule (as distinct from its electron pair geometry) is decided by:
(Molecule ki asal shakal (electron pair geometry se alag) kis se tay hoti hai?)

options.text: atoms ki jagah, lone pairs ko chhor kar

blocks.explanation: Electron pair geometry kul pairs se, aur asal shakal lone pairs ko chhor kar atoms se tay hoti hai (3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Whereas, the actual shape of the molecule is determined by the atoms excluding the lone pairs.

blocks.prompt:
55 BeCl₂ is linear because the two bond pairs around Be are arranged at:
(BeCl₂ linear kyun hai? Be ke gird do bond pairs kis angle par hain?)
blocks.explanation: Do electron pairs repulsion kam karne ke liye 180° par hote hain: linear AB₂ (3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: BeCl₂ molecule is of AB₂ type with Be as the central atom and two bond pairs around it

blocks.prompt:
56 Each F–B–F bond angle in BF₃ is:
(BF₃ mein har F–B–F bond angle kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: BF₃ trigonal planar hai aur har F–B–F angle 120° hai (3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: BF₃ molecule has a trigonal planar shape with each F-B-F bond angle of 120°

blocks.prompt:
57 Which hydride is expected to have a trigonal planar geometry like BF₃?
(Kis hydride ki geometry BF₃ jaisi trigonal planar mutawaqqa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Group 3 (III-A) ke hydrides AlH₃, GaH₃, BH₃ mein yahi geometry mutawaqqa hai (3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: The similar geometries are expected in the hydrides of group 3 (III-A)

blocks.prompt:
58 The shape of SnCl₂ (in the vapour phase) is:
(SnCl₂ (vapour phase mein) ki shakal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sn do bonds banata hai aur aik lone pair rakhta hai; shakal v-shaped aur angle 120° se kam (3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: The actual shape of SnCl₂ is v-shaped and bond angle less than 120°

blocks.prompt:
59 Which molecule has all three regions around the central atom occupied by double bonds and a perfectly trigonal structure?
(Kis molecule mein central atom ke gird teeno jagahein double bonds se bhari hain aur banawat bilkul trigonal hai?)
blocks.explanation: SO₃ mein teeno jagahein S=O bonds hain; banawat bilkul trigonal aur angles 120° (3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: The structure of SO₃ is perfectly trigonal with each angle equal to 120°.

blocks.prompt:
60 SO₂ is angular because:
(SO₂ angular (v-shaped) kyun hai?)

options.text: tikon ka aik kona lone pair aur do kone S=O bonds hain
is ke chaar bond pairs hain
is par koi lone pair nahi
is ke do S=O bonds 180° par hain

blocks.explanation: SO₂ mein tikon ka aik kona lone pair ka hai, is liye molecule SnCl₂ ki tarah angular hai (3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: one corner of the triangle is occupied by a lone pair and the other two corners each by a double bond

blocks.prompt:
61 A tetrahedral shape has how many bond angles?
(Tetrahedral shakal mein kitne bond angles hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tetrahedron ke chaar kone, chaar faces, chhe edges aur chhe bond angles hote hain (3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: The tetrahedral shape has four corners, four faces, six edges and six bond angles.

blocks.prompt:
62 Each H–C–H bond angle in methane is:
(Methane mein har H–C–H bond angle kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chaar bond pairs regular tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf hain; har angle 109.5° (3.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Each H-C-H bond angle is perfectly 109.5°.

blocks.prompt:

bond banne ki wajah nahi batata

aadhe bhare orbitals ka seedha (head-on) overlap

S ke orbitals bare hain aur lone pair zyada repulsion karta hai

aik s aur teen p orbitals
aik s aur aik p orbital

magnetic field ki taraf khinchti hai
